articles.title: Sands China’s Community Revitalization Programme Unveils ‘The Hall of Glory – Iec Long Firecracker Factory’
articles.rawDate: Nov.17 Sands China’s Community Revitalization Programme Unveils ‘The Hall of Glory – Iec Long Firecracker Factory’
articles.summary: Sands China unveiled The Hall of Glory at the former Iec Long Firecracker Factory, a new permanent attraction developed with Professors Jeffrey Shaw and Sarah Kenderdine and local and international teams. The exhibition preserves Macao’s century-old firecracker heritage on its original site as a cultural tourism landmark.

articles.title: GEG Collaborates with DSAL and Local Organizations to Support the Professional Growth of Local Team Members
articles.summary: Galaxy Entertainment Group collaborated with Macau’s Labour Affairs Bureau (DSAL), local associations and higher education institutions on professional training and skills certification; since the start of 2026 about 1,500 local team members completed over 16,000 training hours. Through the GEG Chef Development Program, GEG became the first integrated tourism and leisure enterprise in Macau to work with DSAL and FAOM on advanced Chinese cuisine chef occupational skill assessments.

articles.title: Wynn Hosts 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards Kick-Off Event in Shanghai
articles.summary: On November 9 in Shanghai, Wynn hosted a kick-off event for the 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards, themed “Three Years in the Making, A New Chapter Begins.” Wynn announced the 2027 calendar, with judging week in Beijing from August 21–25 and the annual awards ceremony in Macao on October 29.

articles.title: GEG Donates MOP700,000 to Tung Sin Tong to Support Its Annual Fundraising Campaign for the 23rd Consecutive Year
articles.summary: Galaxy Entertainment Group donated MOP700,000 to Tung Sin Tong’s annual fundraising campaign, its 23rd consecutive year of support. Since 2004, GEG has donated more than MOP11 million to the charity.

articles.title: Sands China Supports Tung Sin Tong’s Annual Fundraising Campaign for 23rd Consecutive Year
articles.rawDate: Nov.11 Sands China Supports Tung Sin Tong’s Annual Fundraising Campaign for 23rd Consecutive Year
articles.summary: Sands China donated MOP 700,000 to the Macau Tung Sin Tong Charitable Society at a cheque presentation at The Venetian Macao, marking 23 consecutive years of support for the annual fundraising campaign.

articles.title: Sands China Donates Over MOP 400,000 in Funds and Prizes to Support Caritas Macau Bazaar and Charity Run
articles.rawDate: Nov.10 Sands China Donates Over MOP 400,000 in Funds and Prizes to Support Caritas Macau Bazaar and Charity Run
articles.summary: Sands China donated funds and gifts valued at over MOP 400,000 to Caritas Macau for the 2026 Charity Run and the 57th Charity Bazaar, its 23rd consecutive year of support. 150 Sands Cares Ambassadors also volunteered at both events.

articles.title: MGM Supports Tung Sin Tong’s Annual Charity Event for the 19th Consecutive Year
articles.summary: MGM donated MOP700,000 to Tung Sin Tong’s annual fundraising campaign for the 19th consecutive year, bringing cumulative donations to MOP10 million. A cheque presentation was held at MGM COTAI.

articles.title: Mr. Francis Lui Named Asia’s Most Influential Industry Leader for the 10th Time; Advancing Innovation and Industry Development
articles.summary: Francis Lui, Chairman of Galaxy Entertainment Group, was named the most influential industry leader in the 2026 Asian Gaming Power 50 for the 10th time. GEG COO–Macau Kevin Kelley was also named to the list; the gala was held at Galaxy Resort.

articles.title: Chef Tam's Seasons at Wynn Palace Once Again Ranks Among The 50 Best Restaurants 2026 51-100 List
articles.summary: Chef Tam's Seasons, the signature Cantonese restaurant at Wynn Palace, once again ranks among The 50 Best Restaurants 2026, taking the No.73 spot on the 51-100 list and remaining the only restaurant in Macao on the ranking. It also ranked No.7 in The 50 Best Restaurants Asia 2026, announced in March — the third consecutive year it has been the only Macao restaurant on that list.

articles.title: The “1st Greater Bay Area Health and Longevity Summit & Awards Ceremony” concludes successfully in Macao
articles.summary: The 1st Greater Bay Area Health and Longevity Summit & Awards Ceremony, sponsored by Melco, concluded at Studio City on November 5 with more than 360 guests and 25 speakers from 10 regions. The event closed with an awards ceremony honoring 17 GBA organizations and individuals for contributions to Big Health, medical innovation and the integration of healthcare and tourism.
